_readme: Copy this file to data/seed/<any-name>.json (data/ is not in git) and start the app (start.bat).
It is applied once on start-up; edit it and restart to apply new items. Existing data is never overwritten.
Accounts without a password get a generated one, written to data/seed/seed-accounts.txt.
The first account becomes admin when the install has no accounts yet.
Put your own LLM keys in llm_providers in YOUR copy only; never commit keys.
Format reference: pathmind/services/seed.py. Knowledge is written like the Samples page (headings + @id/@label/@rel lines).
